context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed API regression tests (17/17 pass) plus existing solver suite (37 pass earlier and during full run). UI tested on 1920x800 and 390x844 with real screenshots: auto compute, edits invalidate stale results, validation, empty/no-fit/all-fit, capped node limits (1/10), replay controls, mode isolation, stale async solve protection, delayed save behavior, save/restore/delete persistence, and overflow checks passed. Only open issue is runtime hydration warning in console around option/select rendering path.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open optimizer and inspect browser console while tree inspector select is present. Console repeatedly logs HTML nesting warning ('<span> cannot be child of <option>') pointing to SearchTree inspector path and emergent runtime wrapper. Mitigation: ensure option children are plain text only at render/runtime and verify no wrapper injection or component abstraction inserts span within option.
